rationale: A connected architecture overview with progressively focused numerical inspections.
core_model: one complete small untrained encoder-decoder Transformer and autoregressive generation
simplifications: One layer per stack instead of six; d_model=4, h=2, d_ff=8 instead of the base 512/8/2048.
Fixed deterministic untrained weights. Output tokens are not a translation.
Training, dropout and label smoothing are explained, not performed. BLEU, parsing and ablation results are sourced, not reproduced.
Gain controls are illustrative interventions: 100% preserves the baseline equations; changing them is an experiment, not a paper-reported hyperparameter sweep.

controls.label: Source sentence
controls.units: 0: I see cats · 1: I like cats

views.shows: Encoder and decoder towers joined by cross-attention, with per-lesson computations

guided_steps.title: Two stacks. One path from input to output.
guided_steps.do: Change the source sentence from “I see cats” to “I like cats”.
guided_steps.notice: The source token changes, encoder memory changes, and the decoder receives a different memory.

guided_steps.title: Words need positions before attention.
guided_steps.do: Switch positional encoding off and compare token 0’s vector.
guided_steps.notice: The cosine contribution disappears from the odd components; the input to the encoder changes.

guided_steps.title: Inside one encoder layer.
guided_steps.do: Inspect head 1, then compare the two head outputs, concatenation and encoder output.
guided_steps.notice: The heads produce different vectors. Concatenation has four components; the feed-forward and normalization steps change them again.

guided_steps.title: The decoder has two kinds of attention.
guided_steps.do: Enable the causal mask; then cut the encoder memory connection.
guided_steps.notice: Future attention mass becomes exactly zero. Cutting memory makes the cross-attention output zero, while the decoder still has its prefix.

guided_steps.title: Predict a token. Feed it back. Repeat.
guided_steps.do: Increase “Tokens to generate” from one to three.
guided_steps.notice: The generated sequence grows, the shifted prefix includes earlier generated tokens, and the probability distribution is recomputed.

guided_steps.title: What was trained—and what this demo proves.
guided_steps.do: Move the schedule from step 4,000 to step 8,000.
guided_steps.notice: The learning rate falls after warmup. The reported BLEU scores stay in the evidence panel because this demo does not train or measure translation quality.
